verdicts.reason: A is mostly a shrunk copy of the original with almost no rearranging. The pill tags and the URL become very small, and about 150px of the bottom is dead space with only the stray asset box in it. B is worse because of collisions: the line '6:00 pm… Pier 9' runs into the can and its green dots, and the subtitle's second line sits right on top of 'Saturday 21 June' with no gap. B also crams the info block close to the RSVP button and still leaves a large empty bottom third.
